evidence: Has 'TX fees and policy' label and modifies `src/txmempool.cpp` and `src/policy/fees/mempool_estimator.cpp` to match transactions by wtxid instead of txid.
rationale: Fixes a false-positive tracking bug in `removeForBlock` where alternate witness variants skew fee estimation calculations and fail to emit conflict signals. Correcting fee estimator accounting avoids distorted feerate buckets, though differing witness variants are an uncommon edge case.
